intended_use: Inference-time rubric and rule-scope context; not a training-rights determination.
rights_note: The bundle paraphrases project interpretations. IOGP icons and official accompanying wording are not redistributed. Source rights for incident documents remain tracked separately.

sources.title: IOGP Report 459 and Life-Saving Rules supporting materials

passages.text: Judge realistic potential for fatal or life-altering harm from the described task, energy or substance, person position, and stated controls. Actual injury severity is separate. Missing essential facts require unknown.
A control is present when stated in place, failed when stated not to perform its intended function, missing when explicitly absent, and unknown when not described well enough.
IOGP positions the Life-Saving Rules as worker-focused final barriers rather than replacements for management systems, competent people, site rules, or procedures.
Life-Saving Rule relevance or non-conformance and potential fatal severity are separate judgments; one does not determine the other.
bypassing_safety_controls is relevant when the observation concerns disabling, overriding, removing, or working around a safety-critical protection or safeguard.
confined_space is relevant to entry or work in a confined space, including authorization, isolation, atmospheric testing, attendant, communication, and rescue readiness.
driving is relevant to road or site vehicle operation, including fitness, seat belts, journey controls, speed, distraction, and mobile-device use.
energy_isolation is relevant when hazardous electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, pressure, thermal, chemical, or other stored energy must be isolated and verified before work.
hot_work is relevant to flames, sparks, heat, or other ignition sources where flammable material or atmosphere may be present and controlled authorization or testing is material.
line_of_fire is relevant when a person may be struck, crushed, caught, released upon, or otherwise harmed because of position relative to moving equipment, objects, pressure, or gravity.
safe_mechanical_lifting is relevant to lift planning, competent operation, lifting-equipment condition, load control, exclusion zones, and exposure beneath or near suspended loads.
work_authorisation is relevant when defined authorization, task risk assessment, permit scope, control confirmation, handover, or reassessment after a change is material to the work.
working_at_height is relevant when a person could fall from an unprotected elevation or opening and fall prevention, fall arrest, anchorage, access, or dropped-object controls are material.

BSEE safety alerts may combine incident circumstances with later recommendations. Recommendations are learning material and are not evidence that a control was present or absent in the submitted observation.
